Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner treated a search-engine snippet as authoritative and stated that Wikipedia listed Abdul Wahab Khan Tarzi’s death as 20 January 1999 without opening and verifying the actual article (which indicates 20 January 1994). This unverified reliance on a snippet propagated an incorrect date and could lead to the wrong conclusion (that Olaf Everson died first) instead of the correct answer (Abdul Wahab Khan Tarzi).
